bio.text: Mae Peshlakai is a Democratic member of the Arizona House of Representatives for District 6, according to the Arizona Legislature's member page.
According to the 2024 candidate-submitted voter guide, Peshlakai was born on the Navajo Nation, is Dine' of the Tangle People Clan, and is an artist who owns a small business.

The profile says Peshlakai was instrumental in creating the Dine' Bi Arts and Crafts Cooperative in the 1970s and has taught weaving and silversmithing at institutions including Wheaton, Beloit, Wooster and Gettysburg colleges.

sources.title: Voter Education Guide, 2024 primary: Legislative District 6 (candidate-submitted statements)
